name: TQ3-R1
description: TQ3-R1 was a droid with silver and yellow plating and a gray sensor. It had two legs, a cylindrical body, and a dome-shaped head. In 35 ABY, the droid was on the planet Kijimi in the Thieves' Quarter workshop of the droidsmith Babu Frik, a member of the Spice Runners of Kijimi.
